column1: # excluded_environment_trap: clause ③ — files whose source of truth is outside this repo; NOT archived.
# excluded_index_cluster: clause ① — topic-*.md shards ARE the new index's cluster entries; NOT archived.
# misarchive_policy: 观察期 14 天内（observation_start 起）若某归档文件被找回（被读/被引用），
#   `mv <archive>/<name> <memory-dir>/<name>` 移回原位，并在此清单追加一行 reason 含 `misarchive`
#   记为误归档；该行是判据「观察期无找回」的唯一载体，⛔ 不要靠记忆。
